# bookrunch

> bookrunch is a comprehensive tech news and comparison resource for e-readers, ebook software, audiobooks, and digital publishing tools.

The site provides expert comparisons of e-ink devices (Kindle, Kobo, Onyx), reading apps across iOS/Android/Mac/Windows/Linux, self-publishing platforms, and related digital library management tools. It features editor's book reviews focused on technical topics and serves as a discovery platform for book technology enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- E-readers
- Ebook apps
- Audiobooks
- Kindle
- Kobo
- Onyx Boox
- Self-publishing
- Digital publishing
- Book discovery
- Library management
- Ebook converters
- Reading apps
- Tablets for reading
- Note-taking e-readers
- Calibre

## E-Reader Devices

- [Top 10 e-Ink book readers](https://www.bookrunch.org/top/ereader): Comparison of e-ink devices: Kindle Paperwhite, Kobo Libra, Kindle Oasis.
- [Top 10: Tablets for e-Reading](https://www.bookrunch.org/overview/tablets_for_e-reading): Tablets for e-reading: Onyx Boox Go gen2, e-ink tablets comparison.
- [Kindle Scribe alternatives. Top 10 Note-taking e-Readers](https://www.bookrunch.org/alternatives/kindle_scribe): Kindle Scribe alternatives: reMarkable, note-taking e-readers.
- [Kobo Sage alternatives. Top 10 e-Readers](https://www.bookrunch.org/alternatives/kobo_sage): Kobo Sage alternatives and e-reader device comparison.

## Reading Apps & Software

- [Top 10 eBook Readers (reading apps)](https://www.bookrunch.org/top/readerapp): Top reading apps comparison: FBReader, AlfaReader, eBoox, cross-platform.
- [Top 10 eBook software and apps](https://www.bookrunch.org/top/app): Popular ebook apps and software: Kindle, Amazon ecosystem overview.
- [Top 10 Audiobook players](https://www.bookrunch.org/top/audiobook-players): Top audiobook players: Apple Books, Smart Audiobook Player, iOS/Android.
- [Audible alternatives. Top 10 Audiobook apps](https://www.bookrunch.org/alternatives/audible): Audible alternatives and audiobook apps comparison with Libby.
- [Kobo alternatives. Top 10 Ebook apps](https://www.bookrunch.org/alternatives/kobo): Kobo alternatives and ebook apps comparison guide.

## Self-Publishing & Content Creation

- [Top 10 eBook self-publishing platforms](https://www.bookrunch.org/top/selfpublish): Self-publishing platforms: Kindle Direct Publishing, Kobo Writing Life.
- [Top 10 Ebook Creation software](https://www.bookrunch.org/top/creation): eBook creation tools: Scrivener, Kindle Create for self-publishing.
- [Top 10 eBook Converters](https://www.bookrunch.org/top/converter): eBook conversion tools: Calibre, Epubor, Convertio for EPUB/MOBI/PDF.

## Book Discovery & Management

- [Top 10 Book Review and Discovery sites](https://www.bookrunch.org/top/site): Book discovery platforms: Goodreads, LibraryThing, StoryGraph.
- [Top 10 eBook Organizers](https://www.bookrunch.org/top/organizer): Comparison guide for eBook organizers: Calibre, LibraryThing, Google Books.
- [Top 10 Library Management Software](https://www.bookrunch.org/top/library): Library management systems: Koha, Insignia, Bibliovation comparison.
- [Top 10 Article Management software](https://www.bookrunch.org/top/article): Reference management: Mendeley, Zotero, EndNote for academic research.

## Content & News

- [bookrunch - Book Tech News](https://www.bookrunch.org): Homepage featuring book tech news, e-readers, and digital publishing.
- [bookrunch | Editor's Book Picks & Reviews](https://www.bookrunch.org/books): Editor's book reviews and picks on programming, Java, technical topics.
